Container.Name: Director-Studio
Container.Overview:
Director Studio - local-first pre-production UI. Planning LLM is the existing Ollama container; image/video jobs go to the existing ComfyUI-Nvidia-Docker on the RTX 3090. This container is an orchestrator only and does not need a GPU.
WebUI: http://TOWER:8790
Uses host networking so 127.0.0.1:8188 (ComfyUI) and 127.0.0.1:11434 (Ollama) are the same sockets already published on Tower. Do not switch this to bridge unless you also change DS_COMFY_BASE_URL and DS_OLLAMA_BASE_URL.
ALL APP DATA LIVES ON THE ai SSD: /mnt/ai/appdata-ai/director-studio/data -> /data
NOTE: the image is BUILT LOCALLY, not pulled. Force Update will fail because director-studio:latest is not on a registry. To update: cd /mnt/ai/appdata-ai/director-studio && docker compose build then restart this container from the Docker tab.
NOTE: do not add NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES here. ComfyUI already owns the 3090 and Ollama can see all three GPUs. Director unloads the Ollama model before a Comfy job (DS_VRAM_POLICY=exclusive).
NOTE: pick the Director model in the WebUI, not in this template. Good local choices already on Ollama: qwen3:32b, qwen3.6:latest, qwen3:14b.
Container.Requires: Build the local image first: cd /mnt/ai/appdata-ai/director-studio && docker compose build. ComfyUI-Nvidia-Docker and ollama must already be running.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host-network WebUI port. Changing this also requires DS_PORT to match.

Config.Name: App data (projects, library, jobs)
Config.Description: Durable Director Studio data on the ai SSD.

Config.Name: Comfy workflows
Config.Description: API graphs. Tower uses qwen_image_edit_2511_bf16 in place of upstream fp8mixed.

Config.Name: DS_HOST
Config.Description: Listen address inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0 so the LAN can open the WebUI.

Config.Name: DS_PORT
Config.Description: Must match the WebUI Port above.

Config.Name: DS_DATA_DIR
Config.Description: In-container data path. Leave /data unless you also change the App data mount.

Config.Name: DS_COMFY_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Existing ComfyUI-Nvidia-Docker (RTX 3090). GPU1 is :8190, ComfyUI-3D is :8193.

Config.Name: DS_OLLAMA_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Existing Ollama container.

Config.Name: DS_LLM_PROVIDER
Config.Description: ollama, lm-studio, or openai-compatible.

Config.Name: DS_DIRECTOR_VISION_MODEL
Config.Description: Ollama tag for Director chat and Picture inspection. DavidAU Defiant Fable 9B Q8 uncensored VL. Aligned fallback: qwen3.5:9b-agent.

Config.Name: DS_DIRECTOR_NUM_CTX
Config.Description: Ollama context. 32k fits HauhauCS 9B on the 5060 Ti.

Config.Name: DS_QWEN_EDIT_EXTRA_LORA
Config.Description: Extra Qwen Image Edit 2511 LoRA stacked after Lightning in actor and Layout graphs (uncensored MCNL v1). Empty disables.

Config.Name: DS_QWEN_EDIT_EXTRA_LORA_STRENGTH
Config.Description: Strength of the extra Qwen Edit LoRA.

Config.Name: Director app code
Config.Description: Live backend so Tower patches apply without rebuilding the image.

Config.Name: Director UI
Config.Description: Built Vite UI. Rebuild with npm run build in src/frontend.

Config.Name: DS_DIRECTOR_AGENT_RUNTIME
Config.Description: legacy (Linux default) or harness.

Config.Name: DS_DIRECTOR_MAX_TOOL_TURNS
Config.Description: How many Director tool rounds one chat message can run (legacy runtime). Raise this if chat hits the tool-calling safety limit during Picture review. Range 1–64.

Config.Name: DS_H3_PROVIDER
Config.Description: local = ComfyUI H3. minimax = official MiniMax API (needs the API key below).

Config.Name: DS_VRAM_POLICY
Config.Description: exclusive unloads Ollama before Comfy. shared = Ollama on 5060/4070, Comfy on 3090, both stay loaded.

Config.Name: DS_LLM_KEEP_LOADED
Config.Description: Keep the Director LLM loaded between chat turns. Comfy jobs still unload it first.

Config.Name: DS_H3_MINIMAX_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional MiniMax official API key. Leave empty for local ComfyUI H3 only.
